youtube_title: Brain Freeze From Ice Cream? Fix It In Seconds | Body Fix #29 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #29. Big bite of kulfi... and a sudden ICY pain in your forehead? Brain freeze!
B is right. Press your TONGUE to the roof of your mouth. It warms up, pain fades.
Cold hits the palate, vessels react, nerves send pain to your forehead.
Fix: Tongue up, sip something warm, eat cold stuff slowly. It's harmless.
Red flags: Headache that stays, with fever, or sudden and severe? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Cleveland Clinic - brain freeze
